column1: # Model Id (the I/O List Part No. without spaces)
column3: Catalog Item (SYCON.net device catalog: PROFINET IO > Master | Slave | Gateway / Stand-Alone Slave > this item; a bracketed suffix names the DAP the catalog info pane cites when several entries share the name and the GSDML - e.g. PN/PN Coupler X2 [DAP X2 V4.2])
column4: Modules (iolist = the I/O List cards by slot tag are plugged | iolink-ports = the IO-Link ports X01..X08 configured from the connector rows | default = the catalog defaults stay)
column5: GSDML (the file whose catalog entry is taken - the catalog lists one entry per version)

column6: Hilscher cifX 80 compact PCI card = the PROFINET IO controller of the sorter PC (the second card of a redundant pair is skipped)

PN/PN coupler - the X2 side faces the sorter network (I/O List Connector X2); the five same-named catalog entries are the DAPs V1.0 / V2.2 / V3.0 / V4.0 / V4.2 of this one GSDML - V4.2 is the 6ES7 158-3AD10 hardware (user 2026-10-23)

ET200SP interface module - its cards come from the I/O List slot tags. The 2021 V2.35 file on purpose: with the 2024 V2.43 file SYCON.net 1.500 logs 'CreateSubModule failed' and the first DI module ends without a submodule (user 2026-10-23: "use the 2021 gsdml")
ifm IO-Link master 8 x M12 - its 8 Ports module's port submodules follow the I/O List rows (the Fives TAG_IFM_PROFINET_AL1202 rules)
SCALANCE XC216-4C switch - not configured in SYCON.net (the catalog has no XC216 entry)
